name: PIN / password lock screen without TEE
description: Huawei's user_auth and pin_auth HDI services keep credentials in their TEE (iTrustee), which sweet does not have: a PIN could be set but the lock screen stayed swipe-only. They are replaced by OpenHarmony's own REE implementation (drivers_peripheral user_auth 3.0 / pin_auth 2.1, OpenHarmony-5.1.0-Release, Apache-2.0), which keeps the PIN data salted and hashed in /data/service/el1/public/{pinauth,userauth}.
